program_name: Master Universitario en Inteligencia Artificial (Master's Degree in Artificial Intelligence / MUIA)

tuition_notes: ARITHMETIC from the official UPM public-price table (Decreto 43/2022, Comunidad de Madrid), which publishes a SEPARATE COLUMN headed "Estudiantes Extracomunitarios (*)". MUIA is not named in Anexo I, so it falls under "Resto de masteres": non-EU rate = EUR 84.07 per credit x 60 ECTS = EUR 5,044.20 for a full year. The page states this total verbatim: "Un curso completo (60 ECTS) en primera matricula: 5.044,20 EUR". RATE BASIS - IMPORTANT: the EUR 84.07 non-EU figure is NOT the first-enrolment price. The Spanish/EU first-enrolment price for this band is EUR 45.02/credit (EUR 2,701.20/yr). Under Decreto 43/2022 (Comunidad de Madrid) art. 8, non-EU non-residents are charged the THIRD/FOURTH-enrolment credit price instead, and UPM's own second table confirms the mechanism: for "Resto de masteres oficiales" the columns read Segunda matricula EUR 71.88, Tercera EUR 84.07, Cuarta EUR 84.07, and "Estudiantes Extracomunitarios (*) - Todas las matriculas" EUR 84.07. So the client pays the top-of-scale rate from day one, for every enrolment, i.e. 1.87x the EU first-enrolment price - EUR 5,044.20 rather than EUR 2,701.20. Quoting the first-enrolment price here would understate the real cost by 87%. The decreto's footnote confirms a student stay authorisation does not confer residence: "(*) Nota: A estos efectos, la autorizacion de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real Decreto 1155/2024..." - so the client cannot fall into the Tipo 1 / resident band. DO NOT GENERALISE THIS PER-CREDIT FIGURE ACROSS SPAIN: the surcharge MECHANISM differs by region. Madrid applies the third/fourth-enrolment rate (this row and URJC AD-065). Valencia instead doubles the base rate - UPV publishes EUR 35.34 (Tipo 1) vs EUR 70.68 (Tipo 2) per credit, giving EUR 4,240.80 for 60 ECTS on rows C-079 and G-094. The two mechanisms happen to land near each other here but are not the same rule. Add EUR 250 place-reservation deposit (deducted from tuition afterwards, non-refundable if you do not enrol). Payment can be single or split into eight instalments.
